observation: Round 2 recovered precision and edged past the anchor (proxy 0.648 -> 0.607 -> 0.653; correspondence_f1@15 0.368 -> 0.290 -> 0.377) but the gain is marginal because recall on the far-from-scanner half of the map is still missing. In the round-2 detected_lines.png the oblique set is now clean: 16 oblique lines, every one a K-block edge on the 1072/1288 or 1497/1713 rows, no bolt-hole pseudo-obliques in the dense centre, ring 6 back on the 1180 row (initial_prompt_points.png shows a clean two-row stagger 1180/1605 with pitch ~242 px, 10/10 verticals, ring_count_error 0). Remaining deficits, all on the recall side: (a) ring 1 (x~120) still has no line and its 'assume' prompt sits at y~1120, off both stagger rows; (b) rings 3 and 4 (x~605, ~848) have only one K edge each (negative_slope prompts) - their second edges exist in the joint map as dotted traces but never reach the Hough accumulator; (c) the horizontal (B/A, A/A) joints at y~200/424/849/1936/2361 are detected only over x~950-2050 (about 14 segments); on the four left rings and ring 10 these boundaries have no line at all, and in the anchor overlay they are the largest block of red (unsupported) boundaries, far more numerous than the K edges (5 horizontal joints per ring vs 2 K edges). The persistent orange horizontals are void-edge artefacts (y~30/60, the thick y~2130 band, y~2680) that survive any horizontal threshold in [40,90] because they are dense; they are not addressable with the bounded knobs and raising hough_threshold_horizontal 50->60 in rounds 1-2 did nothing to them while gaining no B/A recall. Stages 1-3 are unchanged and healthy (residual 3.5 cm, NaN 0.101, retention 0.76, fill 0.723), so this is a pure stage-4 line-yield problem in the sparse half of the map.
rule: d6 (joint contrast low in the sparse far-scanner region) -> f_joint_oversmoothed, propagating via inter_stage_dependencies to d7 -> stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (m_line_yield low; assume fallback on ring 1, single-edge prompts on rings 3-4, no horizontal joints on the left rings). Remediation r_relax_hough: lower the accumulator thresholds on BOTH the oblique and the horizontal HoughLinesP paths toward the bounded floor so that sparse, dotted joints (40-60% pixel fill over the fixed 100 px minLineLength) are accepted, and densify the joint cloud (inter_radius to its bound) as the in-bounds analogue of r_lower_depth_threshold. The r_tighten_hough guard that fixed round 1 is retained: maxLineGap_oblique stays at 30 (below the ~50-60 px bolt-hole pitch) and horizontal maxLineGap is fixed at 10 by the prior, so the fixed minLineLength=100 plus small gaps makes bolt-hole rows non-bridgeable regardless of vote threshold or binarisation depth. Vertical guard 560 has held 10/10 through binary_threshold 110 and 130, so the binarisation can be relaxed part-way (120) inside the tested envelope. Tuning order section 7: stages 1-3 validated, detection is the legitimate target; SAM geometry and denoising untouched (no graded per-class signal, y_bounds semantics unverified); unfolding omitted (stage1 locked).
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines on the far-scanner half (ring 1 assume fallback off-row; rings 3-4 single-edge; horizontal B/A and A/A joints undetected on rings 1-4 and 10) with upstream stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed; secondary stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset on ring 1 (K placed at y~1120 instead of the 1605 row). Precision-side f_spurious_lines from round 1 is resolved and must stay resolved.
rationale: Final round: selection keeps the best of rounds 1-3, so the value of this round lies in a decisive recall move, not another small precision hedge. Coordinated overlay: (1) enhancing.inter_radius 0.075 -> 0.08 (bound) so far-ring joint traces are interpolated into denser dotted lines before projection - it cannot bridge bolt holes (pitch 0.25-0.30 m >> 0.08 m). (2) detecting.hough_threshold_oblique 42 -> 40 (bound) so the second K edge on rings 3-4 and the ring-1 K edges, which currently fall just under the accumulator, are accepted; minLineLength 100 and maxLineGap_oblique 30 (kept) guarantee that only continuous >=100 px joints qualify. (3) detecting.hough_threshold_horizontal 60 -> 40 (bound): this is the main lever - the B/A and A/A joints are 5 of the 7 boundaries per ring and are unsupported on half the rings; the horizontal path's maxLineGap is fixed at 10 px, so lowering votes admits sparse straight joints but cannot fuse dashed bolt rows, and the void-edge horizontals are already present at 60 so precision on that path cannot get materially worse. (4) detecting.binary_threshold 130 -> 120: partially reopen the depth cut so the fainter far-ring joint pixels (the centreline residual of up to 3.5 cm shifts their grey level) survive binarisation; the round-1 bolt-hole obliques needed maxLineGap 60 to form and are blocked at 30, and the vertical guard already held 10/10 at binary 110. (5) detecting.hough_threshold_vertical stays 560 (proven at both 110 and 130 binarisation; the 2750 px ring joints vote far above it, so a 10/10 count is preserved). Expected proxy signal: correspondence_f1@15 up through more explained horizontals and K edges on rings 1-4 and 10 (recall), with the oblique set remaining K-edge-only (precision held); det_real_detection_ratio 0.9 -> 1.0 if ring 1 gets a real or horizontal-fallback prompt on the 1605 row; sam_fill_rate ~0.72 unchanged or slightly up as ring 1's K block moves onto its row; depth_nan_ratio unchanged (stages 1-3 untouched); ring_count_error must stay 0.
